Our solution can verify any government issued photo ID and passport from 200+ countries with optional features such as facial recognition, liveness detection, and database checks. Knowledge quizzes, financial account verifications and background checks are available too. There are no minimum monthly commitments or long term contracts. Its pay as you go pricing with volume discounts. If you're looking for a fast, efficient way to prove identity and prevent fraud look no further than Authenticate.
